blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: To understand the reliability of computer vision models in real-world applications, robustness evaluation must examine diverse visual perturbations, yet benchmarks cover only some real-world conditions and physical testing is costly. Paired evaluations link clean and perturbed predictions for the same image, retaining changes in correctness, confidence, and acceptance that aggregate accuracy does not describe. We investigate how this image correspondence supports two needs in robustness evaluation: interpreting paired evaluation results and prioritizing samples for physical testing . To interpret paired evaluation results, we fix both sets of prediction records and vary their correspondence within each class. We prove that classwise correct–correct counts give the same sharp bounds on lost acceptance and mean true-class probability decrease among retained-correct inputs as any feasible five-state refinement. Distinguishing persistent from changed wrong answers can further constrain accepted-error transitions, while shared correspondence can establish policy orderings left unresolved by separate cost intervals. To prioritize samples for physical testing, we retain each image’s synthetic responses and rank clean-correct images by their mean true-class probability under corruption. Across 44 classifiers, testing the highest-risk 20% finds 67% and 45% of failures under mild screen and print recaptures, versus 58% and 36% for clean confidence and 60% and 37% for an equal-size natural-transformation average. With both probability averaging and an A3Rank scoring adaptation, the tested corruption set yields higher mean failure recall than the natural-transform set; differences between scores depend on the source and budget. Together, these findings show that the value of correspondence depends on the evaluation objective: classwise counts suffice for specified reliability bounds, while image-specific synthetic responses improve the allocation of physical tests within the evaluated pool.
blocks.zh: 为了了解计算机视觉模型在现实世界应用中的可靠性,强健性评价必须检查多种视觉扰动,但基准只涵盖一些真实世界的条件,物理测试费用高昂. Paired评价将同一图像的清洁和扰动预测联系起来,保留正确性、信心和接受总体准确性没有描述的变化。 我们调查这种图像对应如何支持强性评价的两种需求:解释配对的评价结果和将样本优先用于物理测试。 为了解释配对的评价结果,我们修正了两套预测记录,并更改了每类中的对应关系。 我们证明,类正确-正确计数对损失的接受和保留-正确输入中真实级概率的下降给予与任何可行的五态改进相同的锐度。 将持续错误的答案与改变错误的答案区分开来,会进一步限制被接受的-过错的过渡,而共享的函文则会通过单独的成本间隔来建立未解决的政策订单. 我们保留每个图像的合成反应, 在44名分类员中,检测风险最高的20%发现,在轻度屏幕和印刷品回收中,有67%和45%的故障,而清洁置信率分别为58%和36%,而同样大小的自然变换平均率为60%和37%。 由于概率平均值和A3Rank评分的调整,经测试的腐败率比自然变换率高;得分之间的差异取决于来源和预算。 这些调查结果加在一起表明,函证的价值取决于评价目标:分类计数足以满足指定的可靠性界限,而图像特定合成反应则改善了被评价池内物理测试的分配.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Understanding the reliability of computer vision models in real-world applications requires examining their responses to diverse visual perturbations, from digital corruptions to physical changes in image capture ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ; Baek et al., 2024 ; Baek et al., 2025 ; Nugent et al., 2025 ) . A fixed benchmark covers only a subset of these conditions, while collecting physical measurements across additional settings requires resources. This creates two needs: extracting useful reliability information from completed evaluations and deciding which images to prioritize in subsequent tests. Aggregate accuracy describes overall correctness but leaves important image-level changes unresolved. For example, an image may remain correctly classified after perturbation while its confidence falls below an acceptance threshold, changing an accepted prediction into a rejection without changing accuracy. Paired evaluations link clean and perturbed predictions for the same image, making such changes observable.
blocks.zh: 了解计算机视觉模型在现实世界应用中的可靠性,需要研究其对从数字腐败到图像捕捉物理变化等多种视觉扰动的反应(Hendrycks and Dietrich, 2019;Baek等人, 2024;Baek等人, 2025;Nugent等人, 2025)。 固定基准只涵盖这些条件的子集,而收集其他环境的物理测量需要资源。 这就产生了两个需要:从已完成的评价中提取有用的可靠性信息,并决定在以后的测试中优先使用哪些图像。 聚合精度描述整体正确性,但留下重要的图像级别变化未解决. 例如,一个图像在扰动后可能仍然正确分类,而其置信度则低于接受阈值,将接受的预测改为拒绝而不改变准确性。 预测性评价将同一图像的清洁和扰动预测联系起来,使这种变化成为可观察的。

blocks.en: How does image correspondence in paired evaluations support the judgments needed in robustness evaluation? For completed tests, without their matching, knowing each side’s predictions does not necessarily reveal which accepted correct predictions became accepted errors or lost acceptance. The answer depends on how the records correspond and what information about that correspondence has been retained. For subsequent physical tests, associating synthetic responses with their source images may help identify which images are likely to fail under real perturbations. We examine this question in image classification through two subquestions: first, which reliability changes and policy comparisons can be determined from separate prediction records and selected joint counts; second, whether image-specific synthetic responses improve failure discovery at a fixed physical testing budget. The first question concerns what the available records establish about completed tests; the second concerns their empirical usefulness for directing further tests.
blocks.zh: 组合评价中的图像对应如何支持稳健性评价所需的判断? 对于已完成的测试,没有匹配,了解双方的预测并不一定显示哪些接受的正确预测成为接受错误或失去接受。 答案取决于记录的对应性以及保留了哪些有关该信函的信息。 在随后的物理测试中,将合成反应与其源图像联系起来可能有助于识别哪些图像在实际扰动下可能失败. 我们在图像分类中通过两个子问题来研究这个问题:第一,从单独的预测记录和选定的联合计数中可以确定哪些可靠性变化和政策比较;第二,针对图像的合成反应是否改善固定物理测试预算中的故障发现. 第一个问题涉及现有记录对已完成的测试有何确定;第二个问题涉及这些测试在指导进一步测试方面的经验效用。

blocks.en: The first part presents our analysis for interpreting paired evaluation results . We hold the clean and perturbed prediction records fixed and vary their correspondence within each true class (Section 4 ). Classwise counts are then added: first the number of images classified correctly in both conditions, followed by the full five-state breakdown of correctness and answer changes. Given the fixed records, correctness overlap provides all five-state endpoint constraints for lost acceptance among retained-correct inputs and their mean true-class probability decrease. Distinguishing persistent from changed wrong answers can further narrow accepted-error transitions. Comparing policies under a common feasible correspondence also establishes some orderings that separate cost intervals leave unresolved. The value of the additional counts depends on the policy cost, including whether it tracks where accepted errors originate or counts all accepted errors. These results specify which retained information constrains each target and how those constraints support policy comparison.
blocks.zh: 第一部分介绍我们对配对评价结果的分析。 我们固定了干净和扰动的预测记录,并在各个真正的类别内改变它们的对应关系(第4节)。 然后添加类数:首先在两个条件中正确分类的图像数量,然后是正确性和答案变化的完整五态分解. 鉴于固定记录,正确性重叠为保留正确输入中丢失的接受及其平均真实级概率下降提供了所有五个状态终点限制。 将持久的错误答案与改变的错误答案区分开来,可以进一步缩小被接受的过度过渡。 根据共同可行的函证对政策进行比较,也可确定一些单列费用间隔未解决的命令。 额外计数的价值取决于政策成本,包括政策成本是否跟踪已接受错误的来源,还是计算所有已接受错误。 这些结果具体说明哪些保留的信息制约了每个目标,这些限制如何支持政策比较。

blocks.en: The second part focuses on prioritizing samples for physical testing . We retain each image’s synthetic responses and rank clean-correct images by their mean true-class probability under corruption (Section 5 ). On mild screen and print recaptures, a 20% testing budget finds, on average, 67% and 45% of failures, versus 60% and 37% for an equal-size natural-transformation average. Reassigning synthetic scores to other same-class images reduces screening performance, directly demonstrating the value of matching responses to source images. Crossing both probe sets with probability averaging and adapted A3Rank yields higher mean failure recall for the tested corruption set under both scores, with score preferences varying by source and budget. These comparisons assess image identity and synthetic-probe choice for allocating real tests.
blocks.zh: 第二部分的重点是为物理测试确定样品的优先次序。 我们保留了每个图像的合成反应,并按其平均真实的概率将干净的正确图像排在腐败之下(第5节)。 在温和的屏幕和印刷品回收中,20%的测试预算发现,平均有67%和45%的故障,而同样大小的自然变换平均值为60%和37%。 将合成分数重新分配给其他同级图像会降低筛选性能,直接显示对应源图像的响应值. 跨越两套探测器,其概率平均和经过调整的A3Rank对两个分数下所测试的腐败进行平均失利率较高,其得分偏好因来源和预算而异。 这些比较评估了图像身份和用于分配真实测试的合成-probe选择.

blocks.en: Together, the analyses show that the value of correspondence depends on the judgment an evaluation is intended to support. Classwise correctness overlap already captures all five-state endpoint constraints for two reliability targets given fixed prediction records, whereas image-specific synthetic responses improve real-failure screening within the evaluated pool. More detailed information therefore calls for target-specific assessment: tighter bounds, additional policy orderings and improved predictive performance are distinct outcomes. Section 3 defines the records, response states and information levels; Section 4 develops the identification and policy results; Section 5 evaluates failure screening; and Section 6 examines the different outcome of aggregating responses for model-level prediction.
blocks.zh: 分析表明,函证的价值取决于评价旨在支持的判断。 类正确性重叠已经捕捉了两个可靠目标的五态端点限制,而图像特定合成反应则改进了评价池内的实际故障筛选。 因此,更详细的资料要求进行针对具体目标的评估:更严格的界限、更多的政策命令和改善预测业绩是明显的结果。 第3节规定了记录、反应状态和信息水平;第4节规定了识别和政策结果;第5节评价故障筛选;第6节审查了汇总答复以用于模型一级的预测的不同结果。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Corruption benchmarks, replicated test sets and deployment datasets measure different distribution changes ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ; Recht et al., 2019 ; Koh et al., 2021 ) . Synthetic robustness need not transfer uniformly to natural or perceptually different shifts ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Mintun et al., 2021 ; Kar et al., 2022 ) . ImageNet-ES and ES Diverse provide controlled physical capture variation ( Baek et al., 2024 ; Baek et al., 2025 ) . Effective robustness and accuracy-on-the-line motivate strong clean-performance baselines ( Taori et al., 2020 ; Miller et al., 2021 ) ; pretraining and reference distributions affect these relations ( Djolonga et al., 2021 ; Shi et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 腐败基准,复制测试集和部署数据集衡量不同的分布变化(Hendrycks and Dietrich,2019;Recht等人,2019;Koh等人,2021)。 合成稳健性不需要统一转移到自然或感知不同的转变(Hendrycks等人,2021年;Mintun等人,2021年;Kar等人,2022年)。 图像 Net-ES和ES Diverse提供受控的物理捕捉变异(Baek等人,2024年;Baek等人,2025年)。 有效的稳健性和在线准确性激发了强大的清洁性能基线(Taori等人,2020年;Miller等人,2021年);预训和参考分布影响这些关系(Djolonga等人,2021年;Shi等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Matched outcomes underpin correlated-proportion tests ( McNemar, 1947 ) , negative-flip analysis ( Yan et al., 2021 ; Sawada and Kasahara, 2026 ) and error-consistency studies ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Klein et al., 2025 ) . Bench-C examines confidence and correctness changes under corruption ( Sui et al., 2026 ) , while VLM-RobustBench analyzes harmful and helpful answer flips ( Saxena et al., 2026 ) . Paired evaluations also assess reward-model robustness for language-model alignment by comparing preference rankings or confidence before and after input transformations ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zang et al., 2026 ) . We study what joint counts determine beyond separate records, without claiming novelty for the partition. Calibration, failure detection and selective classification measure different aspects of confidence ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Minderer et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2017 ; Corbière et al., 2019 ; Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ; Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2019 ) . Their behavior can change under shift or without an accuracy change ( Ovadia et al., 2019 ; Galil and El-Yaniv, 2021 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) , requiring explicit protocols and baselines ( Jaeger et al., 2023 ; Cattelan and Silva, 2024 ; Traub et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 匹配结果支撑了相关比例测试(McNemar,1947年),负滑动分析 (Yan等人,2021年;Sawada和Kasahara,2026年)和误差一致性研究(Geirhos等人,2020年;Kim等人,2025年;Klein等人,2025年). 法官席 - C审查了腐败下的信任和正确性变化(Sui等人,2026年),而VLM-Robust Bench分析了有害和有益的答案翻转(Saxena等人,2026年). Paired评价还通过比较投入转换前后的偏好排名或信心,评估语文模式调整的奖励模式稳健性(Wu等人,2025年;Zang等人,2026年)。 我们研究什么是联合计算 超越单独的记录, 不声称新颖的分割。 校准,故障检测和选择性分类测量信任的不同方面(Guo等人,2017年;Minderer等人,2021年;Hendrycks and Gimpel,2017年;Corbière等人,2019年;Geifman and El-Yaniv,2017年;Geifman and El-Yaniv,2019年). 其行为在转动或没有准确变化的情况下可以改变(Ovadia等人,2019年;Galil和El-Yaniv,2021年;Liang等人,2024年),需要明确的协议和基线(Jaeger等人,2023年;Cattelan和Silva,2024年;Traub等人,2024年).

blocks.en: PRIMA uses input and model mutations with learning to rank to prioritize test inputs ( Wang et al., 2021 ) ; A3Rank uses augmentation alignment to prioritize overconfident failures ( Wei et al., 2024 ) . Simple uncertainty scores can be competitive test-prioritization baselines ( Weiss and Tonella, 2022 ) . Averaging predicted-class probabilities over test-time transformations is an existing training-free confidence score ( Bahat and Shakhnarovich, 2020 ) . We use corruption responses of known clean images to prioritize subsequent physical recaptures. At equal inference counts, we compare corruption and natural-transformation averages and adapt the A3Rank scoring rule to both probe sets; its original rejection component and current-input error target are distinct from our future-recapture task.
blocks.zh: PRIMA使用输入和模型突变并学习排位来优先进行测试输入(Wang等人,2021年);A3Rank使用增强调和来优先进行过度自信的失败(Wei等人,2024年). 简单的不确定性分数可以是竞争性的测试优先基线(Weiss and Tonella, 2022 ). 与测试时间转换相比, 我们利用已知的清洁图像的腐败对策来优先处理随后的人身回收。 在同等的推论计算上,我们比较了腐败和自然变换平均值,并将A3Rank评分规则适用于两套探测器;其原始的拒绝组件和当前输入错误目标不同于我们的未来回收任务.

blocks.en: Joint distributions constrained by their marginals are a classical problem ( Strassen, 1965 ; Tchen, 1980 ; Kellerer, 1984 ) . Stratified intersection bounds also quantify treatment harm ( Kallus, 2022 ) , while partially identified counterfactual utilities support policy comparison ( Ben-Michael et al., 2024 ) . We use elementary intersection counts and extremal subset sums; our structural question is which correctness and wrong-answer constraints alter these endpoints. Finite-record identification differs from sampling inference for partially identified parameters ( Imbens and Manski, 2004 ) . Proper scores and CORP quantify probability quality ( Gneiting and Raftery, 2007 ; Dimitriadis et al., 2021 ) ; totals need no correspondence, unlike allocation to response states. Alternative ImageNet annotations delimit what correctness means ( Beyer et al., 2020 ; Vasudevan et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 受边缘限制的联合分配是一个古典问题(Strassen,1965年;Tchen,1980年;Keller,1984年)。 分级的交叉界限也量化了治疗伤害(Kallus, 2022 ),同时部分确定了反事实公用事业支持政策比较(Ben-Michael等人, 2024 ). 我们使用基本的交叉计数和极端的子集数;我们的结构性问题是,哪些正确性和错误的回答制约改变了这些终点。 有限记录的识别不同于部分确定参数的取样推论(Imbens和Manski,2004年)。 适当分数和CORP量化概率质量(Gneiting and Rafrey,2007;Dimitriadis等人,2021);总数不需要对应,与响应状态的分配不同。 备选图像网络说明界定正确性的含义(Beyer等人,2020年;Vasudevan等人,2022年)。

Both correspondences give one retained-correct pair and one harmful flip, with identical classwise five-state counts. Yet matching the accepted clean prediction to the correct perturbed one loses acceptance while retaining correctness; the other matching produces an accepted error. The counts therefore need not determine which accepted prediction failed. We ask what remains possible as increasingly detailed joint counts supplement the report.

A statistic may use both sides without depending on their correspondence, as a difference of marginal means does. blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement

blocks.en: We provide supplementary code and documentation to support reproduction of the experiments and analyses. The supplementary materials specify the fixed image identities, development/evaluation splits, perturbation conditions, scoring protocol, and the 44 evaluated models and their statistical groupings, together with the 450-cell panel described in Section 4 . Detailed inference settings, split definitions, and threshold conventions are provided in Appendix F , while the accompanying documentation provides instructions for obtaining the data and running the experiments. Model checkpoints and the datasets are obtained from their original sources; access to some weights (e.g., DINOv3) might require the official access procedure. The clean images are identical to those used in the study, and predictions on the physical recaptures reproduce the recorded results. For synthetic perturbations, the original per-image corruption seeds were not retained. Regeneration therefore follows the documented experimental protocol without guaranteeing pixel-level identity with the original perturbed images.

blocks.en: Every score in this comparison is derived from a common evaluation of the 44 models on the 1,000 base images under 49 input variants: the clean image, 18 corruptions and 30 natural transformations. Model loading, preprocessing, mixed precision and scoring follow the original evaluation procedure. Single-precision cosine similarities for OpenCLIP models, 1,000-class logits for supervised and linear-head models, and learned logit scales and SigLIP biases support the alternative scoring calculations. Three agreement tolerances were specified in advance: at least 99% prediction agreement, mean absolute probability difference at most 0.01, and clean accuracy difference at most 0.5 percentage points. The repeated evaluation reproduces the recorded clean and corruption class predictions and probabilities exactly for all 44 models and all 19 conditions (Table 30 ); the resulting U U and S S AUROCs agree with Table 16 to 10 − 16 10^{-16} . This confirms computational consistency on the same GPU model using the original procedure and the documented contemporary library versions. Scores recomputed from the single-precision outputs differ from the recorded half-precision probabilities by at most 0.009 and change the predicted class for at most 0.8% of images near ties. The common protocol applies softmax to cosine similarities multiplied by 100 for OpenCLIP models and to the 200-class logit subspace for other models. Native scoring uses the learned scale (14 to 117), sigmoid probabilities with the learned scale and bias for SigLIP, and full 1,000-class softmax probabilities for supervised and linear-head models. The text classifier, candidate-space predictions and eligible images remain fixed across scoring rules. Under native scoring, mean mild-condition AUROC decreases by about 0.02 for clean confidence, U 18 U_{18} and TTA 18 \mathrm{TTA}_{18} (-0.020, -0.022 and -0.022 on ES), while their gaps remain unchanged. At the primary 20% recapture budget, the native-rule coverage gaps between U 18 U_{18} and TTA 18 \mathrm{TTA}_{18} are 0.073 on ES and 0.072 on Diverse.

blocks.en: We evaluate the scoring equations of A3Rank ( Wei et al., 2024 ) on the fixed natural and corruption probe sets, separately. This adds one directly related ranking construction while keeping the same 18 probe evaluations and common clean prediction. Its score is evaluated for subsequent recapture failures, whereas the original work targets errors on the scored input and includes a downstream rejection component. We retain the score’s sums and three roles, but do not train its rejector or reproduce its model-specific training augmentations. The original score has no tuned weights: its alignment terms are summed with equal weight, and its only model-specific ingredient is the variant set drawn from the classifier’s training augmentations, which we replace by the fixed probe sets. PRIMA’s learned ranking with input and model mutations uses different resources ( Wang et al., 2021 ) ; no performance comparison with that pipeline is claimed here.

blocks.en: These exploratory checks compare additional scores on the same image pool and model predictions as the primary analysis. The three added scores were fixed before calculation. blocks.en: Syn and the real pool overlap in 209 images, including 63 Syn-development/real-evaluation overlaps; cross-source image populations are therefore not independent. The development-accuracy tiers contain 44/51 mild, 5/25 severe and 5/86 extreme ES/Diverse conditions. Model-level prediction uses all Syn images or Syn-B development images to predict real evaluation targets.

blocks.en: We evaluate models over the candidate classes defined for each dataset, using a common scoring protocol to obtain categorical probabilities. The study thus compares models under a shared scoring convention rather than assessing the native calibration of individual checkpoints. Predicted labels, correctness, true-class probabilities, and maximum predicted probabilities are derived from the same inference outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们利用共同的评分协议,对每个数据集所定义的候选类别进行模型评价,以获得绝对概率。 因此,该研究比较了共同评分公约下的模型,而不是评估单个检查站的本土校准。 预测的标签,正确性,真品级概率,以及最大预测概率,都来源于相同的推论输出.

blocks.en: Clean and perturbed images undergo the same model-specific preprocessing. Although the original computational environment and preprocessing configurations were not fully documented, repeating the original inference procedure on the same clean and corrupted images exactly reproduced the stored prediction records for all 44 models, as reported in Appendix E . These records and the accompanying experimental documentation provide the basis for the reported analyses. Table 41 identifies the evaluated checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 清洁和扰动的图像进行相同的模型预处理。 虽然原始的计算环境和预处理配置没有得到充分记录,但如附录E所报告,在同一清洁和腐烂的图像上重复原始推论程序完全照搬了所有44个模型的存储预测记录。 这些记录和所附实验文件为报告的分析提供了依据。 表41列出了经评估的检查站。

blocks.en: We consider nine synthetic corruption types—brightness, fog, snow, contrast, JPEG compression, pixelation, defocus blur, Gaussian noise, and motion blur—at two severity levels, yielding 18 experimental conditions. Additional higher-severity Syn-B images are excluded from the primary analyses. The development and evaluation sets are stratified by class, with fixed image assignments. Because the original per-image corruption seeds were not retained, exact regeneration of the perturbed images is not guaranteed. The severity levels represent nominal experimental conditions rather than calibrated measures of physical perturbation intensity. Figure 7 illustrates the 18 corruption conditions, representative natural transformations used in Section 5 , and mild-condition physical recaptures from ES and Diverse.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个严重程度来考虑九种综合腐败类型, 即光荣、雾、雪、对比、JPEG压缩、像素化、分焦模糊、高斯噪音和运动模糊, 初级分析中不包括更多的高强度合成B图像。 开发与评价集按类别分级,固定图像任务. 由于原始的逐象腐败种子没有被保留,因此无法保证对扰动图像的确切再生. 严重程度水平代表名义实验条件,而不是物理扰动强度的校准度量. 图7说明了18个腐败状况、第5节中采用的具有代表性的自然转变以及从ES和Division中恢复的温和条件。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Examples of three perturbation families for the same base image. Rows 1–2 show synthetic corruptions used in Syn and Syn-B. Row 3 shows representative natural transformations used for comparison. Row 4 shows original physical recaptures from ImageNet-ES and ES Diverse.
blocks.zh: 图7:用于同一基本图像的三个扰动家庭的例子。 第1–2行显示了Syn和Syn-B中使用的合成腐败. 第3行显示用于比较的代表性自然变换. 第4行显示从ImageNet-ES和ES Diversion中原始的物理回收.

blocks.en: The primary fixed-coverage analysis evaluates risk among the highest-scoring 80% of target samples, with ties resolved to maintain the prescribed sample size. The frozen threshold is the lowest score among the highest-scoring 80% of clean development samples. All scores at or above this threshold are accepted, so ties may increase clean-development coverage beyond the nominal level. Fractional-coverage diagnostics instead average over ties at the acceptance boundary. The supplementary 5% risk rule selects the largest top-ranked subset with empirical error no greater than 5% and accepts all scores at or above its cutoff. Including all cutoff ties can change the empirical risk even on the data used to select the threshold. Neither this rule nor the primary frozen threshold guarantees risk control in deployment.
blocks.zh: 初级固定覆盖分析对80%得分最高的目标样本中的风险进行评价,并决心保持规定的样本规模。 冰冻阈值是最高得分80%的清洁开发样本中的最低得分. 所有达到或超过这一门槛的得分都被接受,因此,联系可能会使清洁发展覆盖范围超出名义水平。 分层覆盖诊断在接受边界上平均大于联系。 补充5%风险规则选择经验性错误不超过5%的最大顶级子集,并接受其断点或以上的所有分数. 包括所有截断关系,甚至可以改变用于选择阈值的数据的经验风险. 这一规则和主要冻结门槛都不能保证部署中的风险控制。

blocks.en: The transition, identification, and binary-score analyses use a single, internally consistent set of predictions and probabilities. Full multiclass Brier scores use true-class and collision probabilities from a separate, internally consistent evaluation, available only for Syn and ES; incompatible probabilities from earlier evaluations are not incorporated into these scores. The supplementary clean probability-gap analysis combines gaps from this second evaluation with outcomes from the primary evaluation. Across 484,000 clean prediction records, predicted labels and correctness agree exactly, with small probability differences confined to DINOv3. This agreement does not establish equality of the full probability vectors, and multiclass scores for perturbed inputs remain unavailable for the other sources.
blocks.zh: 过渡、鉴定和二进制分数分析采用一套内部一致的预测和概率。 完整的多级布赖尔分数使用单独内部一致评价的真类和碰撞概率,仅供Syn和ES使用;早期评价产生的不兼容概率不计入这些分数. 补充的清洁概率-差距分析将第二次评价的差距与初级评价的结果结合起来。 整个484 000份清洁预测记录、预测标签和正确性完全一致,小概率差异仅限于DINOv3。 该协议没有规定完全概率矢量的等值,其它来源仍然没有扰动输入的多类分数.

blocks.en: The probability gap is the difference between the largest and second-largest predicted class probabilities. For each model, we define three groups using the one-third and two-thirds quantiles of the gap distribution among misclassified clean development samples, assigning boundary values to the higher group. A model is excluded from the corresponding analysis when fewer than six such errors are available. These cutpoints are defined relative to clean errors, rather than the overall clean population. The analysis does not control for initial confidence and does not support a causal interpretation.
blocks.zh: 概率差是预测的最大和第二大类概率的差. 对于每一个模型,我们用错分类的清洁开发样本中差距分布的三分之一和三分之二的四分位数来定义三个组,将边界值分配给较高组。 当出现不到6个此类错误时,模型被排除在相应分析之外。 这些切点是相对于干净错误而不是整体干净人群来定义的. 分析并不控制初始信心,也不支持因果解释.

blocks.en: F.1 Acceptance protocols and calibration
blocks.zh: F.1 联合国 接受协议和校准

blocks.en: Platt scaling (logistic regression on the logit of S S ) and isotonic regression ( Zadrozny and Elkan, 2002 ) are fitted on clean development records per model and source and applied to both sides. Under the quantile protocol of Section 3.3 (80% clean-development coverage), a strictly increasing calibrator cannot change any acceptance decision; Platt scaling reproduces the raw decisions in all 88 model–source pairs with zero difference, and isotonic steps would only create ties that inflate coverage. Table 40 shows that calibration does change H H , L L and selective risk under absolute thresholds: at a threshold of 0.9, H H falls by roughly 60% and selective risk from 7.9 to 5.4 points on ES. Whether calibration matters for a rejection rule is therefore decided by the protocol in this setting rather than by the model alone. No calibrator is fitted on the perturbed side.
blocks.zh: Platt缩放(在S S 的对数上进行逻辑回归)和同位素回归(Zadrozny和Elkan,2002年)被安装在每个模型和源的清洁发展记录上,并适用于双方。 根据3.3节(80%的清洁开发覆盖)的量子协议,严格增加的计算器无法改变任何接受决定; Platt 缩放在所有88个模型中复制原始决定 — — 源代码对,零差异,同位素步骤只会产生扩大覆盖范围的联系。 表40显示,校准确实改变了H H 、L L 和绝对阈值下的选择性风险:在0.9的阈值下,H H 下降了约60%,在ES上,选择性风险从7.9点降至5.4点。 因此,校准是否涉及拒绝规则的问题由协议在这一背景下决定,而不是仅由模型决定。 扰动侧面没有装有焦距器.

H H , L L and selective risk are expressed as percentages; coverage is the fraction of perturbed inputs accepted. Selective risk is the error rate among accepted perturbed inputs.

blocks.en: ImageNet supplies the classification reference task ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) . Table 41 lists the evaluated checkpoints. blocks.en: I.3 Common lost-acceptance target
blocks.zh: I.3 共同的失认目标

blocks.en: The observed L from the identification analysis and the real L k L_{k} used for prediction agree across all 88 model/source targets to 3.55 × 10 − 15 3.55\times 10^{-15} percentage points after restricting identification to the same mild conditions. On these conditions, mean per-cell L widths are 6.14 to 5.01 for ES and 5.68 to 4.05 for Diverse when overlap is added. These are compatible bounds on each fixed cell; a single common permutation across conditions is not required. The Syn-to-real prediction comparison instead receives source summaries and learns from other model groups’ real targets. The contrast therefore connects the same event across two different tasks, without equating bound width with forecast error.
blocks.zh: 从鉴定分析中观察到的L和用于预测的真实的L k L_{k}在所有88个模型/源指标中,在将鉴定限制在同样温和的条件下之后,一致达到3.55×10−15 3.55\times 10^{-15}百分点。 在这些条件下,每细胞L的平均宽度为ES的6.14至5.01,在增加重叠时,Diversal的为5.68至4.05. 这些是每个固定单元格上相容的边框;不需要在各种条件之间进行单一的普通排列。 相反,Syn-to-Real预测比较收到源摘要,并学习其他模组的实际目标。 因此,对比点将同一事件连接在两个不同的任务上,而不将约束宽度等同于预测错误.

blocks.en: I.4 Numerical verification of prediction comparisons
blocks.zh: I.4 预测比较的数字核查

blocks.en: The analysis comprises 49,280 out-of-fold model predictions, with finite predictions and interval estimates for every planned fit. The full-cohort C1 and sequential d ​ M k dM_{k} gains agree with the earlier results to within 10 − 8 10^{-8} percentage points. Independent calculations verify training-only preprocessing and nested prediction, including whole-group exclusions; eight independently refitted prediction groups differ by at most 7.11 × 10 − 15 7.11\times 10^{-15} percentage points. The sensitivity analysis uses the existing model predictions and takes 199.84 seconds on CPU.

blocks.en: I.5 Unpaired synthetic information is a useful starting point
blocks.zh: 一.5 未经认证的合成信息是一个有用的起点

blocks.en: These checks address the label sensitivity discussed in Section 7 , covering annotation changes, cross-model error agreement and the status of human recapture review.

blocks.en: J.1 Matched ReaL evaluation and candidate compatibility
blocks.zh: J.1 匹配的ReaL评价和候选人兼容性

blocks.en: ReaL provides accepted-label sets for original ImageNet images ( Beyer et al., 2020 ) . We map the model’s 200-class prediction through its synset to the standard 1,000-class index, retain the original image identifier, and compare original and ReaL correctness on the same evaluation images. Of the shared 500 evaluation images, 473 have nonempty accepted-label sets; 27 are excluded from both sides of this matched comparison. This is distinct from the primary original-label analysis on all 500 images.
blocks.zh: ReaL 为原件提供已接受的标签集 ImageNet的图像(Beyer等人,2020年). 我们通过该模型的二百级预测与标准的千级索引进行映射,保留原始图像标识符,并将原始和ReaL的正确性比较在同一评价图像上. 在共享的500张评价图像中,473张有非空的被接受的标签集;27张不包括在这个匹配的比较的两侧. 这与所有500幅图像的主要原始标签分析不同。

blocks.en: Of those 473 images, 435 have at least one accepted label among the 200 candidates and 38 have none. The latter remain in the main matched sensitivity analysis: every available prediction is wrong under their ReaL sets. A separate split gives 424 images whose original label is retained and 49 whose original label is removed. These partitions explain annotation sensitivity; the 435-image subgroup supplements the full matched analysis.
blocks.zh: 在这473幅图片中,435幅在200名候选人中至少有一张被接受的标签,38幅没有。 后者仍然停留在主要的对应灵敏度分析中:每个可用的预测在其ReaL集下都是错误的. 单独的拆分给出了424张原标签被保留,49张原标签被删除的图像. 这些分区解释注释灵敏度;435-图像分组补充了完全匹配的分析.

blocks.en: J.2 Cross-model support for a clean wrong answer
blocks.zh: J.2 跨模式支持干净的错误答案

blocks.en: On the original-label 500-image evaluation pool, we select images a given model gets wrong when clean and measure how many other models predict that same clean wrong answer. We compare exclusion of the evaluated model, exclusion of its whole group, and equal weighting of other groups. Low/high support means agreement at most 0.25/at least 0.75; the middle group contains the remaining values. The outcome is whether the model retains that same wrong answer after perturbation, with each group’s clean-error events as denominator.
blocks.zh: 在原始的标签500图像评价池上,我们选择一个给定的模型在清洁时会出错的图像,并测量其他多少模型会预测同样的干净错误答案. 我们比较了排除被评价模式、排除整个模式组以及同等重视其他模式组的情况。 低/高支持表示协议最多0.25至少0.75;中间组包含剩余值. 结果是模型在扰动后是否保留同样的错误答案,每个组的清洁-错误事件作为分母.

blocks.en: Table 49: Persistent same-wrong rate conditional on original-label clean-wrong events among all 500 images, stratified by other-family clean-side consensus (high ≥ 0.75 \geq 0.75 ; low ≤ 0.25 \leq 0.25 ).
blocks.zh: 表49:长期相同的错误率,条件是在所有500幅图像中发生原始标记的清洁错误事件,由其他家庭的清洁方共识分级(高 0.75\geq 0.75;低 0.25\leq 0.25)。

blocks.en: Excluding the evaluated group (Table 49 ), high/low-support persistent-error rates are 61.45%/27.10% on ES and 18.69%/6.40% on Diverse. These rates weight model–condition–image events; they are neither the unconditional state proportion s s nor independent-image probabilities. The association does not control clean confidence and cannot establish an independent effect, a new predictive increment, or label correctness. Shared model errors may also reflect shared biases ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 不包括被评价的组别(表49),高/低支助持久性异常率在ES为61.45%/27.10%,在多样性为18.69%/6.40%。 这些速率加权模型 - 条件 - 图像事件;它们既不是无条件的状态比例s,也不是独立的图像概率. 协会不控制净信心,无法建立独立效应,新的预测增量,或标签正确性. 共享模型错误也可能反映共享偏差(Geirhos等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: J.3 External annotations and pending human review
blocks.zh: J.3 外部说明和待人审查

blocks.en: We match the detailed ImageNet-Mistakes resource by original image and the specific predicted label, not by image alone ( Vasudevan et al., 2022 ) . The matching yields 16 distinct model–image–resource combinations across two base images, represented by 32 source-specific matches because ES and Diverse share the clean images. This sparse coverage cannot explain persistent errors across the full pool.
blocks.zh: 我们通过原始图像和具体的预测标签来匹配详细的ImageNet-Mistakes资源,而不是仅仅通过图像(Vasudevan等人,2022年)。 匹配可产生16个不同的模型-图像-资源组合,它们跨越两个基础图像,由32个特定源匹配来代表,因为ES和Divers分享干净的图像。 覆盖面太小,无法解释整个人才库持续的错误。

blocks.en: The planned two-reviewer assessment comprises a stratified sample of 200 of the 27,537 events across 18 strata, with inclusion probabilities equal to each stratum’s sample-to-population ratio. Each event specifies a source, condition, base image and persistent wrong answer, and an image may recur across events. The 400 assigned ratings remain unannotated, so human assessment and adjudication results are pending. Reviewers are masked to model identity, consensus and ReaL annotations and evaluate the displayed candidate answer. Estimation will account for unequal inclusion probabilities and repeated images.
blocks.zh: 计划中的两次审查者评估包括一个分层抽样,对18个阶层的27 537项事件中的200项进行抽样,其列入概率相当于每个阶层的抽样与人口比率。 每个事件都指定了一个源,条件,基图像和持续错误的答案,一个图像可能会在事件之间重现. 所分配的400个评级仍未加说明,因此尚未作出人文评估和裁定结果。 审查者被蒙上模版身份,共识和ReaL说明,并评价显示的候选人答案. 估计将考虑到不平等的包容概率和重复的图像。
